visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a wide shot of the entrance to the Yilan National Center for Traditional Arts under a bright blue sky. Two large, curved red and white floral-patterned moon sculptures stand prominently on a grey brick-paved plaza. Visitors, including a man pushing a luggage trolley, move toward the building entrance. (2) The scene shifts to close-up shots of children. A young girl in a maroon shirt sleeps in a purple and blue stroller. The camera pans to another child in a white tank top sleeping in a black stroller. A third, younger girl in a teal outfit is shown awake and sitting in a beige wagon next to stacked packages. (3) The children are then seen running excitedly down a traditional-style street with red-brick buildings. Colorful lanterns and decorative elements hang overhead across the street. The girl in the maroon shirt runs toward the camera with a joyful expression. (4) A toddler in teal walks through a narrow alley with large red lanterns casting circular shadows on the ground. She then runs toward the camera, joined by her older sister. (5) The children sit in their wagon, watching a street performance. A performer is seen hunched over a suitcase on a red-carpeted stage. A close-up shows the girl in the maroon shirt watching the show with a transfixed and curious expression. (6) The video concludes with a pink screen featuring a simple cartoon illustration of a girl and the text 'POPO'S DAILY LIFE'.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a cheerful female voice greeting the audience over an upbeat acoustic guitar melody featuring a steady 4/4 rhythm. The sound is clean, indicative of a high-quality field recording. (2) As the video shows children sleeping, the female voice speaks softly, followed by a male voice commenting on the situation. The rhythmic clicking of wheels on pavement is audible underneath the continuing guitar BGM. (3) The energy increases with high-pitched children's laughter and shouting. The female voice becomes more animated, using a rising intonation to encourage the kids. The music remains bright and constant. (4) A transition occurs where the music shifts to a slower, more atmospheric traditional plucked-string melody during the performance scene. The female voice speaks in a hushed, observant tone. (5) The video ends with a short, bright melodic jingle that mirrors the visual logo reveal, quickly fading to silence.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: A family travel vlog aimed at documenting and sharing the experiences of a trip to the National Center for Traditional Arts in Yilan. It highlights the playful and wholesome nature of a family outing, showing children sleeping, playing, and being engaged by traditional culture.
